name: EPIC 220505371
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 8, 13.6 solar radii and 1.14 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 220505371 (K2 campaign 8): PARAM radius (solar radii) 13.635276 (16th-84th percentiles 12.892581-14.434663), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 1,673 parsecs away, 14 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 8, give 1.14 solar masses and 13.6 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,659 K at its surface.
